source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    split = next((("v", c) for c in range(1, w - 1) if 2 * c + 1 == w and len({row[c] for row in grid}) == 1), None)
    if split is None:
        split = next((("h", r) for r in range(1, h - 1) if 2 * r + 1 == h and len(set(grid[r])) == 1), None)
    if split is None:
        raise ValueError("No centered uniform divider found")

    axis, k = split
    if axis == "v":
        first = [row[:k] for row in grid]
        second = [row[k + 1:] for row in grid]
        out_h, out_w = h, k
    else:
        first = grid[:k]
        second = grid[k + 1:]
        out_h, out_w = k, w

    shared_colors = {value for row in first for value in row} & {value for row in second for value in row}
    mismatch_color = next(iter(shared_colors))
    return [[3 if first[r][c] == second[r][c] else mismatch_color for c in range(out_w)] for r in range(out_h)]
'''
